notes.title: Stray Gods, a brand new game announcement and an upcoming Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Happy April folks! We hope you survived April Fools okay.

We come bearing news! 

Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical
First of all, as we mentioned in our 2024 sign off, Stray Gods will always be adored by us, but won't be receiving any further updates at this time. However, this doesn't mean we don't have more potential Stray Gods surprises in the pipeline... but no news just yet! 

We'll always be in touch here to let you know about anything new and exciting and Stray Gods related, but for the next little while, our focus is on what's next - and with that...

Today we're unbelievably thrilled to announce Malys, coming this year and coming soon to Kickstarter! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/f5ba148e950dc7d9313568a7bf2dd94c57b8c327.jpg

If you've been paying attention on our socials, you might've noticed we've been teasing something for a little while. As Noah, former priest turned exorcist and demon hunter, you ride the streets of a festering city in the dead of night. The city teems with demons, and among them lies your prey: Malys, a demon of extraordinary cunning and power. Use your deck to expose the rot within. Find unique combinations and strategies to withstand the horrors. Help the hopeless and free the possessed, or die in the attempt… over and over again.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/08a550287c417acda3ac18d2bdf705e50ef93436.png

FAQS

If you're signed up to our newsletter you might've seen us address some questions from players, but just in case you missed it...

Is Malys set in the Stray Gods universe?
Malys is a brand new adventure in a brand new world. We're leaving Stray Gods on the shelf for now, but not necessarily forever.

Will there be romance in Malys?
There aren't any planned romance mechanics for Malys at this time. There is absolutely yearning. 

There will always be yearning.

Is Malys a musical?
Malys is not a musical, but music and sound will always be core to the games we make. We aren't saying we'll never go back to the musical format, but we're excited to explore new genres as a team. 

Why a roguelite deckbuilder?
Honestly?  If you've played or read anything by our creative director David Gaider, you probably know he loves demons. What you might not know is that he also loves deckbuilders. It’s a game genre that David is a real fan of. Malys is a concept that's been burning away in Dave for a long time - just like Stray Gods existed conceptually way back when he worked at Bioware.  We wanted to take our love for characters and genre-twisting stories to tackle a brand new adventure, and that adventure is Malys.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/b6f4459ec417d43f0e1d528aa15d3a3b36a25059.png

Just like we brought Stray Gods to Fig, we're now bringing Malys to Kickstarter in a few weeks. We know that working with all of you to get feedback and collaborate on the final phase of development is going to give Malys the best chance of success. With your help, we can work with you through the Kickstarter to allow us to get a full 1.0 in your hands within the next six months of this campaign launching. 

We need you to make Malys a reality in Summerfall's continued goal of creating amazing character driven, story focused, comprehensive single player experiences free of microtransactions and never-ending roadmaps. 

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/adea25631a56363830ad33b2926385d901d527c7.png  
Click above or here to sign up to our pre-launch page and join the hunt. Signing up for notifications means you'll be first to learn more about Malys AND gain access to rewards when Kickstarter launches.

notes.title: It's Orphtober with 30% off Stray Gods Orpheus!
notes.content:
It's that time of year again - Melbourne International Games Week! Each year Melbourne International Games Week runs during October, when the sun finally decides to join us here in Melbourne (yay!). It's a mix of events for industry, players, and more - including PAX Australia!

What could be better in October than surprises? As a TREAT for you in honor of the not one, not two, but THREE AGDA's we won last year, we're putting Orpheus on sale for the first time at a whopping 30% off.

This year, we're taking things a little more gently than our hectic last year, but we wanted to still share the love with you of course! Last year we had a bumper week. In case you missed it, we: 


 held a live free Stray Gods Fashion Show in Federation Square, a huge outdoor space in Melbourne. 
 David (creative director), Ben (art director) and Liam (managing director) were the focus of a Directors in Conversation evening at ACMI, Australia's national museum of screen culture.
 had a panel at PAX Australia where we shared Secrets, Stories, Myths and Mistakes from behind the scenes of Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical
 had a bunch of the team speak at Games Connect Asia Pacific, the local games industry conference.
 and most exciting of all - won THREE awards at the Australian Game Developers Awards including Game of the Year, as well as Excellence in Music and Excellence in Accessibility. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123933/0dce7fb86e30487a54b26c81e5b332e82a9edfe5.jpg

So grab the game, or grab a cuppa and peep some of the things you might have missed from last year. You can keep up to date with us via our socials - despite a Reddit comment asking if we'd shut down, we are in fact, still kickin', still makin', and full of secrets. Hehehe.

xoxo,

Summerfall Studios

notes.title: Stray Gods: Orpheus is OUT NOW
notes.content:
The bard is back! 

Orpheus’ story is arguably finished - until Hermes brings him back to the world of the living. Guide Orpheus through the depths of mortal decision making - who to date, what to hope for, what instrument to rock out on… Starring Anthony Rapp, Erika Ishii, and written by David Gaider, Stray Gods: Orpheus is a comedic feature length experience that history buffs, hopeless romantics, and rock stars alike can enjoy.

Experience 6 brand new original songs, composed by Austin Wintory, with lyrics by Simon Hall (Tripod), Montaigne and new addition Tom Cardy. When the curtain has fallen and the show is over, who do you go home as? Is the mortal world ready for the return of Ancient Greece’s most infamous bard?

Play Stray Gods: Orpheus NOW!

[previewyoutube=vD6pWMvkPjU;full][/previewyoutube]

If you run into any issues, please do report them via our technical thread in the discussion boards.

A huge thank you to our team and to you - our players. Your love for Stray Gods is everything to us and we can't thank you enough!

You can share your journey with us on our socials - TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, and Facebook. 

Knock 'em dead!

Love,

Summerfall

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical Patch
notes.content:
Hello folks!

With Stray Gods: Orpheus about to take the stage, we thought it'd be a great time to revisit Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical with some updates & fixes in one final and beefy patch. Thanks to those of you who have reached out to the team along the way and helped us investigate these issues — our team couldn't have done it without you!

Today’s final Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical patch includes the following:

Gameplay

- Fix for bug where trait selections were incorrectly inaccessible
- Fixes for bugs when pausing during load screens/audio descriptions
- Additional Optimization
- Several minor cinematic fixes
- Minor environmental tweaks

Menus/UI

- Fixes for Option Menu bugs (some visual and technical)
- Update to New Game Menu to make overwriting saves more explicit
- Removed Gamesight functionality
- Re-sized UI scaling to handle localized text
- Re-localized some text that was not translated
- Fix for some subtitles not appearing
- Improved controller navigation
- Support for Stray Gods: Orpheus

We hope these fixes find you well - and just in time to enjoy Stray Gods: Orpheus! 

It’s about time for an encore don’t you think?

xoxo, 

Summerfall

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical - Patch #1.2
notes.content:
Hey folks,

We recently released a patch with a number of fixes but unfortunately upon release some players encountered unexplained crashes. Because of this, we made the decision to roll it back.

We're happy to say we're releasing a new patch today!

This patch includes the following fixes:

 Fixed voiceover equalisation, which brings the volume of each character’s VO into alignment.
 Fixed a number of issues that were causing crashes.
 Fixed various issues where binding actions to specific keys didn't work as intended.
 Fixed some localisation issues.
 Removed brackets from some speaker labels to make them more readable. (The last encore for our beloved ‘Ibothi’ and ‘Ialli’)
 Fixed an issue where you could get similar conversations with Pan one after the other during the Medusa storyline.
Thank you again for your support and feedback. As always, if you encounter any further issues please reach out to us via our support form so our team can investigate.

And a 5 6 7 8!

notes.title: Patch Rollback
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thank you so much for your enthusiasm for Stray Gods as we continue to improve the game.

Earlier today, we soft launched a Patch #1.1 on Steam, which aimed to address the audio imbalance, localisation fixes, some keybinding issues, and more. However, we are receiving reports that the patch is causing some game crashes.

We have decided the best course of action is to roll back this patch and re-release it after we’ve remedied the problem. 

We are very thankful of the patience of our community!

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical - Patch #1.1
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We hope you have been enjoying your ‘time to shine’ with our idols in Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical.

Thank you again for all of your feedback and bug reports. They have enabled us to investigate and address a number of issues which have been fixed in today’s patch.

The most commonly reported issue was the uneven volume levels, and that has now been corrected. Our gods are now in perfect harmony with one another - no more extra quiet Muses or super sonic Goddesses to be seen!

In today's patch we have:

 Fixed voiceover equalisation, which brings the volume of each character’s VO into alignment.
 Fixed a number of issues that were causing crashes.
 Fixed various issues where binding actions to specific keys didn't work as intended.
 Fixed some localisation issues.
 Removed brackets from some speaker labels to make them more readable. (A fond farewell to ‘Ibothi’ and ‘Ialli’)

If you encounter any further issues please report them via our bug report form for our team to investigate.

May the Chorus judge you kindly!
Summerfall Studios

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical - Hotfix #1.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We appreciate the patience you've given us as we've been investigating this save issue. We believe we have found the cause, and we're here today with a hotfix that we believe will resolve the save issues you've been experiencing.

At present, we believe the issue came up due to the way in which the game was handling initial save files - that is, demo save files had the potential to cause issues with players games if they had them, including crashes. To prevent this, the system is taught to wipe these initial saves to ensure you don't encounter crashes and an unplayable game. However, the way in which the system detects these saves made an error, causing it to identify your first new saves as potential demo saves.

This also accounts for why players do not and have not (at least from our reports) encountered the issue again. We've made adjustments to how the system checks these files and are pushing this build now. 

You should take care not to load any saves from your demo playthrough as it will likely cause issues. Overwriting those saves with new games will ensure everything runs smoothly.

If you encounter any further issues, please do continue to submit via our bug report form.

CHANGES:

 Fix to address save versioning incorrectly deleting saves
Thank you and enjoy Stray Gods!

Summerfall Studios

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical - Save File Loss Information
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Firstly, thank you for your support and celebration on the release of Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical. We are so grateful to see you enjoying the game! 

We've had a few bug reports, but our biggest focus has been those of you affected by issues with save files and progression loss. As avid choice-based narrative fans ourselves, we know how frustrating this can be to lose your progress.

We're getting closer to a fix that should resolve this for players who are booting the game for the first time. Our team are going to be working this weekend to resolve it for you. At this stage, this bug only seems to be affecting players' initial save file - that is your first created save, regardless of save slot. No one has encountered the issue after this point that we know of when they start a second save. If you have, please let us know via the support form below. 

In the interim, we ask that any player launching the game for the first time do the following steps:

1. Launch the game
2. Agree or Decline Gamesight's prompt
3. Exit the game using 'Exit Game'
4. Relaunch the game 

If you'd like to be extra cautious, you can play the first scene until you see the save logo in the top left corner, then exit using 'Exit Game'. While we can't guarantee this will stop every issue from occurring with progression and saves, this should allow you to start a new game with no save file issues. 

We are so grateful for your patience. As a small team in a sometimes challenging timezone, every bit of kindness and Grace (we had to) is appreciated. Your reports allow us to investigate these issues swiftly and effectively, and we know it takes time and energy to submit them. 

Thank you and we hope you enjoy your time with the game,

Summerfall Studios

notes.title: Stray Gods: The Roleplaying Musical Date Update
notes.content:
We’re so excited - Stray Gods is under a month away!

We’re counting the days and we know you are too, but we need to make a slight adjustment to the calendar. We’re moving our launch date to August 10th, 2023.

We want everyone to have ample space to check out Stray Gods when it launches. Baldur’s Gate 3 is hotly anticipated (by us, too!) and we want to give our fans room to celebrate Stray Gods.

We also want everyone to be able to play on their preferred device at launch. This is a huge undertaking for any team, let alone an indie shipping its first title. This extra week allows us to have performance parity as close as possible - across every platform.

We're so excited to share Stray Gods with you and we hope you'll join us on August 10th to play and celebrate this game we've poured so much love into!
